dialogues.speaker: Buranova
dialogues.text: Temperature normal, and port conditions are safe. Clear to proceed.

dialogues.speaker: Buranova
dialogues.text: In other words, the water temperatures at the port are within normal range and should not result in excessive icing that could interfere with shipping operations.

dialogues.speaker: Buranova
dialogues.text: Everyone thinks Sretomorozsk is a natural ice-free port. But a myth is all that is.

dialogues.speaker: Buranova
dialogues.text: We, the surveyors, are the ones who are keeping the port free from ice by monitoring the situation all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Buranova
dialogues.text: Once we discover a large ice formation, we will notify the relevant agencies so they can be prepared to break it up at any time.
